profile.summary: North Region SELPA is a Special Education Local Plan Area in northern Alameda County. It brings together the Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Emery and Piedmont school districts to coordinate special education programs and services for students with disabilities. Albany Unified School District serves as its administrative unit and receives and distributes special education funds.
